summary: Fleet Telemetry API v2 moves all endpoints from /v1/... to /v2/... and bumps FleetSnapshot.api_version from "v1" to "v2"; v1 is deprecated and shuts off 2026-12-01. Orientation breaks from Euler degrees orientation.roll/pitch/yaw (intrinsic Z-Y-X) to required unit quaternion orientation.qx/qy/qz/qw (Hamilton, scalar last). Uncertainty breaks from scalar noise (isotropic 1-sigma, metres) to required 6x6 covariance, plus adds required health (0..1, alert below 0.5).

endpoints_renamed.notes: All endpoints move from /v1/... to /v2/...; v1 endpoints are deprecated and will be shut off on 2026-12-01.

fields_removed.notes: Removed noise (isotropic 1-sigma position uncertainty, metres). Replaced by covariance: 6x6 symmetric pose covariance, position block covariance[0:3][0:3] in m². Migration: anything that weighted by 1 / noise² should weight by the inverse of the position covariance block. A scalar equivalent of the old noise is sqrt(trace(P_pos) / 3).

Removed orientation.pitch (degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X), part of body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll). Replaced by unit quaternion orientation.{qx,qy,qz,qw}, Hamilton convention, scalar last. Server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative. Migration: build rotations from the quaternion directly; do not round-trip through Euler for tilt.

Removed orientation.roll (degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X), part of body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll). Replaced by unit quaternion orientation.{qx,qy,qz,qw}, Hamilton convention, scalar last. Server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative. Migration: build rotations from the quaternion directly; do not round-trip through Euler for tilt.

Removed orientation.yaw (degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X), part of body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll). Replaced by unit quaternion orientation.{qx,qy,qz,qw}, Hamilton convention, scalar last. Server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative. Migration: build rotations from the quaternion directly; if you still need heading, use yaw = atan2(2(qw·qz + qx·qy), 1 − 2(qy² + qz²)); do not round-trip through Euler for tilt.

fields_added.notes: Added 6x6 symmetric pose covariance as nested row-major arrays. Variable order x, y, z (m) then rotation about X, Y, Z (rad). The position block covariance[0:3][0:3] is in m². Migration: anything that weighted by 1 / noise² should weight by the inverse of the position covariance block; scalar equivalent of old noise is sqrt(trace(P_pos) / 3).

Added required composite localisation/drive health from the on-robot monitor, 0..1; 1 = nominal; values below 0.5 mean the robot should be serviced. Ops dashboards should raise a health alert below 0.5.

Added unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll) that v1 encoded. The server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative. Migration: build rotations from the quaternion directly; if heading still needed use yaw = atan2(2(qw·qz + qx·qy), 1 − 2(qy² + qz²)); do not round-trip through Euler for tilt.

type_changes.notes: Changed from EulerOrientation (roll, pitch, yaw in degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X, R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll)) to Quaternion (unit quaternion qx, qy, qz, qw, Hamilton convention, scalar last, same body-to-map rotation; q and -q same rotation, qw may be negative). Migration: build rotations from quaternion directly; heading yaw = atan2(2(qw·qz + qx·qy), 1 − 2(qy² + qz²)).
